from pathlib import Path
from scripts.relocate_lock import digest
lock=Path('requirements/gpu.lock.txt');original=digest(lock)
items=re.findall(r'file:///hy-tmp/driveserve/wheelhouse/([^#\s]+)#sha256=([0-9a-f]{64})',lock.read_text());assert len(items)==36
moved=Path('/hy-tmp/driveserve/s6-wheel-relocation');moved.mkdir()
for name,_ in items:os.link(Path('/hy-tmp/driveserve/wheelhouse')/name,moved/name)
base=Path('artifacts/verification/s6-dependency-portability');base.mkdir(parents=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/relocate_lock.py','--lock',str(lock),'--wheelhouse',str(moved),'--output',str(base/'gpu-relocated.lock.txt'),'--report',str(base/'relocation.json')],check=True)

assert (base/'gpu-relocated.lock.txt').read_text().count(moved.as_uri())==36
assert '/hy-tmp/driveserve/wheelhouse/' not in (base/'gpu-relocated.lock.txt').read_text()
negative=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='s6-wheel-negative-',dir='/hy-tmp/driveserve') as temp:
    temp=Path(temp);bad=temp/'bad';bad.mkdir()
    for label in ['missing','hash_mismatch']:
        if label=='hash_mismatch':
            name=next(n for n,_ in items if n.startswith('aiohttp-'))
            raw=(Path('/hy-tmp/driveserve/wheelhouse')/name).read_bytes();(bad/name).write_bytes(bytes([raw[0]^1])+raw[1:])
        out=temp/(label+'.lock');report=temp/(label+'.json')
        p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/relocate_lock.py','--lock','requirements/cpu-http.txt','--wheelhouse',str(bad),'--output',str(out),'--report',str(report)],capture_output=True,text=True)
        assert p.returncode!=0 and not out.exists() and not report.exists()
        assert ('found 0' if label=='missing' else 'wheel hash mismatch') in p.stderr
        (base/(label+'.log')).write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr);negative.append(dict(case=label,returncode=p.returncode,no_output_created=True))
summary=dict(status='passed',verified_local_wheels=36,original_lock_sha256=original,original_lock_unchanged=True,new_local_directory=str(moved),negative_cases=negative,
 limitation='36 original verified wheels were hard-linked into a new local directory to validate relocation; this is not a second full OSS restore or a host migration. The CPU aiohttp wheel was separately freshly downloaded from OSS.')
